description: This file defines the ClaimExpenseTypeAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing expense types within a claim module of the OrangeHRM system. The class includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting expense types, along with validation rules and annotations for OpenAPI documentation.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseTypeAPI
classes.description: API class providing CRUD operations for Claim Expense Types, including listing, creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion, with validation rules and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all expense types, applying filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new expense type.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove expense types by IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific expense type by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing expense type.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing expense types.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating an expense type.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting expense types.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single expense type.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating an expense type.

methods.name: setExpenseType
methods.description: Sets the properties of an ExpenseType entity from request parameters.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rule for the 'name' property, including entity uniqueness constraint.

methods.name: getClaimExpenseTypeCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates an EntityUniquePropertyOption to ignore soft-deleted records for uniqueness validation.
